propositions: socket.getfqdn() on loopback address 127.0.0.1 blocks for ~35 seconds during HTTPServer construction in macOS CI runners, extending test fixture setup time beyond acceptable bounds
CPython HTTPServer.server_bind invokes socket.getfqdn(host) to populate server_name after TCP bind, but the editor workflow does not consume this field and reverse DNS is not contractually required

A custom _LoopbackThreadingHTTPServer subclass must delegate binding to TCPServer.server_bind and derive server_name/server_port from the literal bound address instead of performing reverse DNS lookup

Editor workflow must start a real loopback HTTP server, bind to ephemeral port, serve workflow requests, and shut down correctly without invoking reverse DNS, while maintaining all existing client-facing behavior (host, port, token, request handling)
